name: Plate XXV: The Orphic Egg
description: The cosmic egg of the Orphics with the serpent of creation coiled about it, from which Phanes, the first-born light, broke forth. Struck in Rubedo: the reddening, the last stage, the Stone made perfect. “QVOD EST SVPERIVS EST SICVT QVOD INFERIVS”: That which is above is as that which is below.
